phase: Issue #154 Phase 2-C2.6-B2-C2B2B: E1 ∩ L1 P1 top-32 reservation contexts searched at the common L1 extent (post-hoc analysis)

captureRule.sentinel: first delivery of the fifth distinct operation cost (never captured)

environment.runtime: Node (Vite SSR loader, one fresh child process per task, NOT a Browser Worker)

conditions.population: B2-C2B1 cohort E1 (extentInsufficient AND k1Minimal) ∩ firstLadderRung L1 (oracle-guided population, declared), cross-checked with the B2-C1 subgroups and the B2-C2B1 required extents: Target IDs only reach the Search runner
conditions.contextSelection: per Target the P1 ranks 1..32 of the schedule re-derived from the Export (derivePhase2C26B2C1Schedule(), Production default extent); no oracle compatibility, firstCompatible, required extent or ladder rung is read
conditions.extentRule: the unchanged reconstructPhase2C26B2B2AContext() at the default extent, then phase2c26b2c2b2bL1Context(): the extent alone replaced by the common L1 extent (B2-C2B1 ladder rung L1), every other field checked identical, the Search input digest recomputed by the unchanged phase2c26b1SearchInputDigest()
conditions.comparedWithB2C2B2A: identical except the extent: the same E1 Targets keep their P1 contexts, capture rule, safety cap, Stage 1 (fresh child, heap 8192 MB, concurrency 1, 10 minutes, no retry / fallback)
searchChildKnows: reservation digest / group / representative alias (re-derived and checked)
searchChildNeverKnows: B2-C2B1 first ladder rung of a Target
conditions.limitation: E1, the L1 rung assignment (the population), P1 and the L1 extent were chosen with post-hoc oracle evidence (B2-C1 / B2-C2B1). This measures only how far, on this Export and this population, searching the P1 top-32 contexts at one common L1 extent without oracle context selection rediscovers the exact oracle Route. It is not evidence that a L1 / L2 ladder, Target-specific extents, P1, a budget of 32 or any capture policy is right for Production or for another Export.

b2c2b2aComparison.note: Diagnostic only, never a decision input or a Production judgement. B2-C2B2A (common L2) is non-formal diagnostic partial evidence; only the contexts both phases started are compared, matched by Target and P1 rank with equal reservation / default Search input digests.

order: B2C2B2B_INVALID: a B2-C2B1 / B2-C1 / B2-B1 authority mismatch, an E1 ∩ L1 population or Target manifest mismatch (a first ladder rung disagreeing with the recorded required extent included), a Target count other than 7, a task count other than 224, a P1 definition drift, a P1 schedule parity mismatch, a context rank duplicated / missing, a reservation digest / origin drift, a task or record extent other than the common L1 extent (a Target-specific extent included), a default / L1 Search input digest drift, an oracle / hash-chain / Export / CalculationContext / RNG mismatch, a recomputed P1 first compatible rank other than B2-C1's, a context mismatch in a Search child, a task outside the manifest or run twice, a Candidate reservation violation (sentinel included), an exact or partial Candidate (or an exact / partial sentinel) from a reservation-incompatible context, a first exact rank before the first compatible rank, a nonmonotonic Candidate cost sequence, a start attestation that is present but does not verify, or a raw / result inconsistency
B2C2B2B_INCOMPLETE: no invalid reason, and a task was not measured (timeout / out of memory / process failure / notRun after an interruption: never Candidate 0, never retried in this Phase)
B2C2B2B_ALL_C8: all 224 tasks measured and C8 reaches an exact Candidate for 7 / 7 Targets within P1 rank <= 32
B2C2B2B_ALL_C4C: all measured, C32 < 7, C4C 7 / 7 (a safety-capped capture still counts its exact Candidates: they lie inside the first four cohorts)
B2C2B2B_INCOMPLETE: all measured, C4C < 7, and a Target without a C4C exact has a safety-capped compatible context in its 32 (its C4C failure is undetermined)

B2C2B2B_PARTIAL: all measured, no invalid reason, C4C < 7 and every missing Target fully determined (0 / 7 is registered here too and flagged); an exact miss is never read as "the Route does not exist"
decisionRule.policies: C8 / C32 = the first 8 / 32 Candidates of the one C4C capture; C4C = every captured Candidate (up to four complete operation-cost cohorts; the sentinel never counts). C8 ⊆ C32 ⊆ C4C
decisionRule.exact: phase2c26b2c2b2aCompareContext() -> phase2c26b2c2aCompareContext() -> phase2c26b2b2aCompare() -> phase2c2OracleCoverage() per Candidate; partial_comparable is recorded and never counted as exact
decisionRule.firstExact: per Target and policy the smallest P1 rank whose context holds an exact Candidate in that policy; every rank 1..32 was searched regardless. first exact rank > first compatible rank is a legal measurement; first exact rank == first compatible rank is an observation, never a selection condition
decisionRule.compatible: phase2c26b2c2aReach() (phase2c26b2c1TargetReach() -> phase2c26b2aReachability()) over the re-derived schedule; must reproduce the B2-C1 P1 first compatible ranks
decisionRule.extent: every task and every Search at the common L1 extent { maxNormalAdvance: 8, maxGogmaAdvance: 235, maxSkillAdvance: 256 }; the schedule / reservation universe / P1 ordering stay at the Production default extent
decisionRule.evidence: separate axis: formal = the ordinary formal conditions AND a verified runner start attestation; an interrupted run is partialRun = true and is graded by the attestation, never automatically non-formal and never promoted by --allow-nonformal

decision.recommendation: timeout / OOM / safety cap / notRunを先に扱う（timeout taskの長時間再測定、resource explosion調査、Search runtime最適化のいずれかをレビュー後に決める）
